bosses.name_ja: 上陸指揮官 ドゥナーク
bosses.reading: じょうりくしきかん ドゥナーク
bosses.style_ja: 拍子を刻む剣士 ― 三拍の督促
bosses.style_en: A metronomic fencer: notices in three beats

attacks.tell_ja: 早斬り ― 合わせれば拍子が崩れる
attacks.tell_en: QUICK CUT: awase breaks his measure

attacks.tell_ja: 上段の重撃 ― 合わせで崩せ
attacks.tell_en: HEAVY OVERHEAD: meet it with awase

attacks.tell_ja: 突き ― 合わせられぬ。転じて脇を取れ
attacks.tell_en: THRUST: cannot be parried; roll to his flank

attacks.tell_ja: 偽りの上段 ― 肩が落ちぬ。合わせず受けよ
attacks.tell_en: FEINT: his shoulder stays up; guard, do not awase

attacks.tell_ja: 梁が落ちる ― 北西から離れよ
attacks.tell_en: FALLING BEAM: clear the northwest

bosses.reading: とりたてがしら ペナルタ
bosses.style_ja: 大盾の重戦士 ― 正面は通らぬ
bosses.style_en: A shield bruiser: the front will not yield

attacks.tell_ja: 盾打ち ― 受けるか合わせ、転じて背へ
attacks.tell_en: SHIELD BASH: guard or awase, then roll behind him

attacks.tell_ja: 槌落とし ― 輪から出て、背の排気口を打て
attacks.tell_en: HAMMER SLAM: leave the ring, then strike his rear vents

attacks.tell_ja: 大回し ― 輪の外へ。目の回る隙に背を打て
attacks.tell_en: HAMMER SPIN: get out of the ring, punish his dizzy recovery

attacks.tell_ja: 延滞の印 ― 円盤を射るか斬れ。踏めば足を取られる
attacks.tell_en: LATE-FEE SEALS: shoot or cut the discs; stepping in roots you

bosses.style_ja: 八メートルの査定機 ― 脚の環と帳簿胴を狙え
bosses.style_en: An 8 m assessor engine: aim for its coils and ledger drum

attacks.tell_ja: 脚の環が光った ― 踏んだ時だけ射よ
attacks.tell_en: A LEG PLANTS: shoot its glowing coil

attacks.tell_ja: 差押え網 ― 錠の音の間に足並みを変えよ
attacks.tell_en: SEIZURE NET: change pace or direction during the lock tone

attacks.tell_ja: 査定光 ― 石の陰に伏せるか、射程の外へ
attacks.tell_en: ASSESSMENT SWEEP: drop behind stone or leave its reach

attacks.tell_ja: 計量の踏み ― 輪を出て、光る四つの環を射よ
attacks.tell_en: WEIGHING STOMP: leave the ring, then shoot all four coils

attacks.tell_ja: 目録放出 ― 印をつける目録を先に落とせ
attacks.tell_en: INVENTORY RELEASE: down the marking drone first

attacks.tell_ja: 目録二機 ― 空の目を先に落とせ
attacks.tell_en: INVENTORY PAIR: down the eyes in the sky first

attacks.tell_ja: 査定 ― 膝をついた今、腹の帳簿胴を斬れ
attacks.tell_en: ASSESSMENT: it kneels; strike the ledger drum

attacks.tell_ja: 減価の薙ぎ払い ― 弧の外へ出るか受けよ。合わせられぬ
attacks.tell_en: DEPRECIATION SWEEP: step out of the arc or guard; it cannot be parried

bosses.name_ja: 工房監督官 タリファ
bosses.reading: こうぼうかんとくかん タリファ
bosses.style_ja: 鉤縄と湯路を操る監督官 ― 外套は湯気に弱い
bosses.style_en: A hazard controller with a tether: steam breaks her mantle

attacks.tell_ja: 鉤縄 ― 合わせで断て。受ければ引きは半分
attacks.tell_en: TETHER LASH: awase snaps the cable; a guard halves the pull

attacks.tell_ja: 二連鉤縄 ― どちらかに合わせて断て
attacks.tell_en: DOUBLE LASH: awase either lash to snap the cable

attacks.tell_ja: 工程棒払い ― 二打とも受け、二打目に合わせよ
attacks.tell_en: ROD SWEEP: guard both hits; awase the second

attacks.tell_ja: 割当打ち ― 輪から出て、隙を打て
attacks.tell_en: QUOTA SLAM: step out of the ring and punish

attacks.tell_ja: 湯路が開く ― 光を読み、橋の上へ
attacks.tell_en: CHANNEL OPENS: read the glow; stand on the bridges

attacks.tell_ja: 織機傀儡 ― 薙刀の間合いで崩せ
attacks.tell_en: LOOM AUTOMATA: break them at naginata reach

attacks.tell_ja: 湯気が噴く ― 離れよ。監督官を誘い込め
attacks.tell_en: STEAM BURST: stand clear, and lure her in

attacks.tell_ja: 全ての湯路が開く ― 渡り橋へ
attacks.tell_en: ALL CHANNELS OPEN: get onto a cross-bridge

bosses.reading: きんこばん エスクロ
bosses.style_ja: 盲目の音の狩人 ― 脈動の間は動くな
bosses.style_en: A blind sound-hunter: stay still while it pulses

attacks.tell_ja: 照合 ― 輪が過ぎるまで動くな
attacks.tell_en: RECONCILIATION PULSE: stay still until the ring passes

attacks.tell_ja: 飛掛り ― 最後の音へ跳ぶ。外させて背を斬れ
attacks.tell_en: POUNCE: he leaps at the last sound; make him miss, then strike his back

attacks.tell_ja: 二段飛掛り ― 囮を二つ、あるいは囮の後に動け
attacks.tell_en: DOUBLE POUNCE: two lures, or lure then move

attacks.tell_ja: 連爪 ― 前で受け、三打目に合わせよ
attacks.tell_en: CLAW FLURRY: guard in front; awase the third swipe

attacks.tell_ja: 棚払い ― 棚の向こうへ降りるか、下がれ
attacks.tell_en: SHELF RAKE: drop to the far side of the shelf, or back off

attacks.tell_ja: 水走り ― 横へ避けよ。水音で居場所が知れる
attacks.tell_en: WADE CHARGE: sidestep; his splash gives him away

attacks.tell_ja: 監査猟犬 ― 灯りを見る。先に落とせ
attacks.tell_en: AUDIT HOUNDS: they see your flame; down them first

bosses.name_ja: 旗艦提督 コラテラ
bosses.reading: きかんていとく コラテラ
bosses.style_ja: 障壁の双銃使い ― 装填の間が隙
bosses.style_en: A gunslinger behind a barrier: her reload is the opening

attacks.tell_ja: 利払いの双銃 ― 照準の間に一メートル半動け
attacks.tell_en: TWIN BURST: move 1.5 m during the laser lock

attacks.tell_ja: 横跳び射撃 ― 照準の間に動け
attacks.tell_en: SIDESTEP BURST: move during the laser lock

attacks.tell_ja: 残高補充 ― 障壁が消える。今撃て
attacks.tell_en: RELOAD: her barrier is down; strike now

attacks.tell_ja: 追証 ― 狙われた遮蔽を捨てて動け
attacks.tell_en: MARGIN CALL: abandon the marked cover and keep moving

attacks.tell_ja: 積荷が滑る ― 低い側から離れよ
attacks.tell_en: SLIDING CARGO: get off the low side

attacks.tell_ja: 目録二機 ― 印をつける目録を落とせ
attacks.tell_en: INVENTORY PAIR: down the marking drones

attacks.tell_ja: 清算刀の二連 ― 二太刀目に合わせよ
attacks.tell_en: LIQUIDATION PAIR: awase the second cut

attacks.tell_ja: 清算の突進 ― 合わせるか、転じて脇を取れ
attacks.tell_en: LIQUIDATION LUNGE: awase, or roll aside to her flank

attacks.tell_ja: 片手撃ち ― 合わせられぬ。横へ避けよ
attacks.tell_en: OFF-HAND SHOT: cannot be parried; sidestep

bosses.name_ja: 大徴収官 ヴァル・アモルト
bosses.reading: だいちょうしゅうかん ヴァル・アモルト
bosses.style_ja: 光線、差押え、そして仕込み杖 ― 最後は無刀取り
bosses.style_en: Beam, seizure, then the sword-cane: end it with mutō-dori

attacks.tell_ja: 帳簿光線 ― 固定された線から横へ出よ
attacks.tell_en: LEDGER BEAM: step out of the locked line

attacks.tell_ja: 取立ての薙ぎ ― 受けるか、合わせるか、間合いから離れよ
attacks.tell_en: COLLECTION CLEAVE: guard, parry, or leave the arc

attacks.tell_ja: 差押え領域 ― 印の床は抜ける。読んで渡れ
attacks.tell_en: SEIZURE FIELD: marked tiles give way; read them

attacks.tell_ja: 担保傀儡 ― 傀儡が立つ限り障壁は落ちぬ
attacks.tell_en: COLLATERAL CONSTRUCTS: his shield holds while they stand

attacks.tell_ja: 仕込み杖の二連 ― 受けるか合わせよ
attacks.tell_en: CANE PAIR: guard or awase

attacks.tell_ja: 仕込み杖の突き ― 合わせられぬ。転じて横から
attacks.tell_en: CANE THRUST: cannot be parried; roll around the line

attacks.tell_ja: 最終差押え ― 納刀して無刀取り。抜刀なら合わせ
attacks.tell_en: FINAL FORECLOSURE: sheathe for mutō-dori; blade drawn, awase

duels.reading: わしお とらのすけ
duels.style_ja: 袋竹刀の三本勝負 ― 急ぐほど隙が出る
duels.style_en: A fukuro-shinai bout to three: the more he hurries, the more he opens

attacks.tell_ja: 面打ち ― 受けるか合わせよ
attacks.tell_en: MEN STRIKE: guard or awase

attacks.tell_ja: 小手打ち ― 受けるか合わせよ
attacks.tell_en: KOTE STRIKE: guard or awase

attacks.tell_ja: 袈裟 ― 合わせて、転じよ
attacks.tell_en: KESA CUT: awase, then roll aside

attacks.tell_ja: 誘い ― 後ろ足が踏まぬ。本物の小手だけに合わせよ
attacks.tell_en: LURE: the rear foot does not drive; awase only the real kote

attacks.tell_ja: 二段 ― どちらの太刀にも合わせられる
attacks.tell_en: TWO-STEP: either cut can be met with awase

attacks.tell_ja: 攻め ― 押し込まれるな。場外は仕切り直し
attacks.tell_en: PRESSURE: he crowds you toward the edge

duels.reading: わしお とらのすけ
duels.style_ja: 真剣の立合い ― 最後は無刀取り
duels.style_en: Real steel: the end is mutō-dori

attacks.tell_ja: 袈裟連撃 ― どの太刀にも合わせよ
attacks.tell_en: KESA COMBINATION: awase any of the three cuts

attacks.tell_ja: 諸手突き ― 合わせられぬ。転じて脇へ
attacks.tell_en: TWO-HANDED THRUST: cannot be parried; roll to his flank

attacks.tell_ja: 見せ上段 ― 下の胴が来る。低く受けよ
attacks.tell_en: FEINTED JŌDAN: the real cut comes low; guard low

attacks.tell_ja: 胴斬り ― 受けよ
attacks.tell_en: BODY CUT: guard it

attacks.tell_ja: 体当たり ― 受けを固めすぎるな
attacks.tell_en: SHOULDER CHECK: do not turtle behind your guard

attacks.tell_ja: 真っ向斬り ― 納刀して無刀取り、または合わせ
attacks.tell_en: VERTICAL CUT: sheathe for mutō-dori, or awase

attacks.tell_ja: 踏込み斬り落とし ― 無刀取り、または柱で線を断て
attacks.tell_en: STEPPING DROP CUT: mutō-dori, or break his line at a post

attacks.tell_ja: 二段真っ向 ― どちらの太刀にも無刀取り
attacks.tell_en: DOUBLE VERTICAL: mutō-dori on either cut
